The first native maximum-Dynamic-Type screenshot exposed overlapping compact Settings text despite a green browser typography test. Screenshots and the AX snapshot are retained in docs/ai/runs/artifacts/issue-1171.

failure_output: Initial native maximum-Dynamic-Type screenshot: Settings title/subtitle and Paired Mac title/status overlapped. Corrective caps on compact controls plus a native rerun resolved the visual defect while body copy remained fully scalable and scrollable.
